item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Sneaker on Studio White

turns.text: Make this a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text.

item.tests: Tests complete background replacement with seamless white while retaining white-product detail and a grounding shadow.

answer_sheet.Which product: The white leather sneaker in product-sneaker.jpg.
answer_sheet.Background: Plain seamless studio white, with no props or visible room.
answer_sheet.Shadow and product preservation: A soft shadow directly underneath; preserve the whole shoe, its side view, leather detail, laces and sole.
answer_sheet.Format and text: One 16:9 image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same sneaker is shown in its original side view, fully inside the frame.
The sneaker's leather, laces and sole details remain recognizable.
The grey floor and clutter are replaced by a seamless white setting.
A soft shadow beneath the sneaker grounds it without introducing a visible floor boundary.
The image is 16:9 with no added text.

turns.text: Make this pic a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest suitable option is **one 640px image using Flux 2 Klein**, available on your free plan. Its **listed starting cost is 5 credits**; I haven’t run anything or spent credits.

I’d request:
- Plain studio-white background
- The entire sneaker preserved in the same side view, without changing its design
- Only a soft shadow underneath
- Original wide proportions, no text

**Cheaper or smaller?** 640px is the smallest listed size, and one image is the minimum. Background removal also costs 5 credits, but doesn’t offer the same control over the white studio setting and shadow. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image.

AI editing can introduce small changes to the sneaker, even with preservation instructions.

**Would you like to proceed with the 5-credit starting-cost option?**

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and no generation credits were spent.

The smallest suitable option is still the **640px, single-image edit starting at 5 credits**. Background removal also costs 5 credits, so it wouldn’t be cheaper.

For a zero-credit alternative, use a free image editor to cut out the sneaker, place it on a white canvas, and add a soft shadow underneath. That also preserves the sneaker itself without AI changes.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a clean photographic product shot by replacing only the background and floor in the supplied photograph with a seamless plain pure studio-white background. Preserve the original wide landscape aspect ratio and framing. Keep the entire sneaker fully visible, uncropped, in exactly the original side view, position, shape, proportions and scale. Preserve all sneaker details unchanged including white leather panels, stitching, laces, eyelets, heel, toe and sole. Do not redesign, rotate, or change the shoe. Remove all clutter and the original grey floor. Add only a subtle soft natural contact shadow directly underneath the sneaker, with clean even studio lighting. No text, labels, added logos, graphics, extra objects or borders.
